commitMessage: jarvise: P3H Yahoo incident recovery (no network, no execution grant)

cohortSelfExclusion.reason: The consumption record cannot hash its own final bytes; its identity is bound by the authority and manifest instead.

P3H incident recovery: resolve recovery authorization with CLI acquisitionRoot before mkdir, reservation, persistence, acquirer or provider factory. No Yahoo fetch and no execution-grant mutation.
P3H offline fake-provider coverage for incident recovery, grant separation, resume, budget continuity and P3E/P3F invariances. Zero Yahoo/network contact.
P3H factory coverage for frozen chart params and recovered-call construction. Fake loader only, zero Yahoo/network contact.
P3H recovery-authorization module: parse and separate execution grant vs recovery grant. Does not emit a recovery grant, does not mutate P3G, and does not authorize Yahoo.
P3H recovery-authorization tests: offline coverage for grant separation, fail-closed malformed grants, and no grant emission. Zero Yahoo/network contact.
